_comment: SHA-256 pins for the ffmpeg/ffprobe sidecars fetched by scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs, keyed by <name>-<rust host triple>. SECOND pin layer on top of the per-archive SHA-256 in the script. ffmpeg 9.0.1 (2026-09-19; replaced the ffmpeg-static 6.1.1 / @ffprobe-installer binaries). Same archives as SundayRec and SundaySync, so the host pins are identical to theirs. The x86_64-apple-darwin pair is the Intel half of the universal macOS release: it cannot be run on an Apple Silicon runner, so the script REFUSES to bundle it unpinned — it is proven by this hash plus its Mach-O arch. All eight computed on the owner's machine from archives first verified against the publishers' .sha256 files.
